name: apiosk-mcp
description: Buy an API call the way a person would: describe the job, see what can do it, compare the candidates on price and measured performance, choose one, and pay for it from a balance you control, under limits you set. The buyer sets the rules at buy.apiosk.com; the gateway enforces them on every call.
author: Apiosk

tools.name: apiosk
tools.description: Return the shared App ranking's top runnable provider, exact price, required inputs and signed offer token for a plain-words job. The attached card provides Approve and Deny. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_connect
tools.description: Report whether this session can buy: connected, payable, which wallet, which policy, which limits. Returns the buy.apiosk.com link when there is no connection. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_discover
tools.description: Describe a job in plain words and get the APIs that can do it, ranked, from the Apiosk catalogue and the wider ecosystem of paid APIs. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_compare
tools.description: Put the candidates side by side on price, measured p95 latency, measured success rate and input fit, each offer carrying a stable offer_id to choose from. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_execute
tools.description: Run the offer the user chose, under the price ceiling they saw, and return the result. This is the one tool that settles a call, from the balance the buyer funded and capped.

tools.name: apiosk_approval_status
tools.description: Read the state of a purchase the buyer's rules put on hold: pending, approved, denied or expired. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_plan
tools.description: Turn a goal that needs several API calls into one plan with one price ceiling, its steps, what it cannot reach, and a signed plan token. The gateway compiles and prices it. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_execute_plan
tools.description: Start the plan the user approved, by plan token and nothing else, and return the job that runs it. This settles the plan's calls from the balance the buyer funded and capped.

tools.name: apiosk_job_status
tools.description: Read where a running plan has got to, what it has used of the approved budget, and what happened since a cursor. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_resolve_job
tools.description: Answer a running plan when it stopped to ask which subject was meant, with a candidate it offered. Spends nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_cancel_job
tools.description: Stop a running plan from dispatching further calls, when the user asks to stop. Calls already sent are still settled.
